description: SROI v2 D405 gripper mask + square extension: the base trapezoid plus a square whose side equals the trapezoid's upper edge (181px), stacked on top (rows 111-292). Covers the manipulation zone where strawberries/leaves/stems move during grasping. Stored as one hexagon polygon per stream (all six corners, including both trapezoid top corners, so no closing-chord wedge is added).
coordinate_convention: Pixel [x, y] coordinates with origin at the top-left; x increases right and y increases down
